text: Recorded T01 streaming envelope in docs/streaming-tables.md and docs/workloads/streaming-tables-v1.json: per scan 2 GiB encoded/decoded, 100M rows, 256 columns, 64 KiB unescaped field, 1 MiB row, 64 diagnostics, 5 min. Single GZIP member with 16 KiB header and complete CRC/size/trailer verification. Generated views cap 2 GiB/file and 8 GiB streamed total. This is table machinery, not new physiological admission coverage; schema/validator and other P01 decisions remain open.
